bug_report_content: Title: node() implementation in DOM and JDOM model Type: Bug | Priority: Minor | Status: Resolved | Resolution: Fixed Description: I think that the code in DOMNodePointer.java, line 120 is wrong because considers only element and document to be matched by node(). while instead it matches any node that pass from there. case Compiler.NODE_TYPE_NODE : return nodeType == Node.ELEMENT_NODE || nodeType == Node.DOCUMENT_NODE; should be changed to case Compiler.NODE_TYPE_NODE : return true; Same in JDOMNodePointer, line 391 return true;//(node instanceof Element) || (node instanceof Document); Comments: [Matthew Jason Benson]: Any chance of a testcase, or at least a hint thereof? [Michele Vivoda]: Sure, I forgot.... XPath: count(//node()) XML: 123.334.3 xalan and saxon result is 7, jxpath gives 3. [Matthew Jason Benson]: After quite some analysis, I agree with your findings, Michele. This is fixed with svn commit 617923.
